mechanism_narrative: A three-week rise in WORKPLACES from -18.3 to -14.9 signals returning commuting routines that lift weekday retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES weekly means improved from -18.3 at t-3w to -14.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing to rise.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT crosses below -20, reduced transit capacity and fear of crowding suppress discretionary trips, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -20 for one weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -19.9 at t-1w and -18.9 at t-0w, near the -20 threshold
failure_condition: After any weekly TRANSIT mean below -20, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS exceeds 30 and GROCERY_PHARM exceeds 8 simultaneously, residents are active and making essential trips; this broad mobility spillover lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS > 30 and GROCERY_PHARM > 8, subsequent 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not higher than the preceding 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: While RESIDENTIAL stays above +2, policy-driven stay-at-home behavior caps discretionary retail even as workplaces recover, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 2.3 at t-0w and WORKPLACES is -14.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL remains above +2 for two consecutive weeks, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not lower than its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal decline from summer outdoor activity, shown by PARKS falling from 43.0 to 32.7 over four weeks, shifts leisure spending indoors and toward retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from 43.0 at t-3w to 32.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: During autumn weeks with PARKS below its four-week trend, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC rebounded from -11.6 to -7.9, crossing above -8; this momentum signals renewed discretionary shopping and predicts further RETAIL_REC gains over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose from -11.6 at t-1w to -7.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: After RETAIL_REC crosses above -8, its mean over the next 28 days is not higher than its mean over the preceding 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES rises above -16 while TRANSIT stays below -18, commuting recovers without transit, shifting trips to cars and away from dense retail districts, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES > -16 and TRANSIT < -18, RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not lower than its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean above 10 indicates essential-only shopping behavior; when this persists, discretionary retail is crowded out and RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM=10.1 at t-0w and 10.0 at t-3w
failure_condition: In weeks when GROCERY_PHARM > 10, the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not lower than its prior 28-day mean.
